title: Roller-supported mesh belt quench and temper line with a closed-circuit cooling tower from Suneng
summary: Suneng and the buyer specified a protective-atmosphere mesh belt quench and temper line. The outdoor cooling water system and the plant's make-up water pipe are separate items.
coverAlt: Roller-supported mesh belt line with a loading table, quenching furnace, oil tank, elevator, washing and drying section, tempering furnace and collection point.
coverCaption: Roller-supported mesh belt line with a loading table, quenching furnace, oil tank, elevator, washing and drying section, tempering furnace and collection point.
seoTitle: Roller-supported belt line: closed-circuit cooling tower
seoDescription: Suneng supplies the outdoor cooling tower, circulation pump and buffer tank. The buyer provides the plant’s make-up water pipe.

presentation.note: The agreement specifies approximately 150 kg/h for quenching and approximately 150 kg/h for tempering, both by weight of parts. Actual rates depend on the parts and loading.
work: Parts: the agreement does not identify the parts.
Material and dimensions: no material grade or individual part dimensions are given.
Output basis: weight processed per hour. A parts-per-hour rate cannot be calculated from weight alone.
features: Upper and lower rollers support and drive the belt in sync, reducing tension during high-temperature conveying.
How do parts leave the oil tank?
An elevator lifts the parts clear of the oil. Side plates help keep them from falling back into the tank.
Who supplies the cooling tower and the make-up water pipe?
Suneng supplies the outdoor system, including a closed-circuit cooling tower, circulation pump and buffer tank. The buyer provides the plant-side make-up water pipe.
params: Effective belt width in the main furnace
presentation.supplier: Suneng designs, manufactures, transports and installs the equipment, wires the controls to the equipment, sends personnel for commissioning and trains operators and maintenance staff.
presentation.buyer: The buyer handles unloading, wiring from the plant supply to the control cabinet, embedded utility connections, external piping and installation materials, and the external make-up water pipe. The buyer provides utilities and parts for commissioning and acceptance, assists with positioning and installation, and leads process commissioning.
presentation.scope: Roller-supported mesh belt quenching furnace, oil quench tank with elevator, washer, tempering furnace, control system and outdoor cooling water system.
presentation.pre: At the buyer's request, both parties check cold operation of the mesh belt, drive chain and control system at the manufacturer's plant.
presentation.site: The agreed output for final acceptance is approximately 150 kg/h. At 800 °C, the quenching furnace is checked at three points. Temperature deviation within the same zone must be within ±5 °C.
faq: What rates are specified for the line with outdoor water cooling?

The agreement lists approximately 150 kg/h for the quenching furnace and approximately 150 kg/h for the tempering furnace. Both figures are by weight. Converting them to a part count requires the weight of one part.
Can I add the two furnace capacities?
No. The figures describe successive stages of one line. The furnaces do not operate as two parallel lines.
Can I request a quote in parts per hour?
Provide a representative part and its unit weight. The agreement specifies throughput by weight and gives no hourly piece count.
presentation.source: Equipment, throughput and acceptance conditions are taken from the technical agreement signed by both parties.
